Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
The lamp is decidedly a bright thought.[^1] I will add a bit about [Miss Nightingale](/person/1086) to the introduction to bring it in appropriately.

Yours very truly
C. M.

Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: It had been decided to use an [illustration](/topic/167) of Florence Nightingale\'s lamp in [A Book of Golden Deeds](/book/51).
